title: Sharp estimates for eigenvalues of localization operators before the plunge region
summary: We study two closely related yet different localization operators: the time-frequency localization operator to the pair of intervals $S_{I, J} = P_I \mathcal{F}^{-1} P_J\mathcal{F} P_I$ and the localization of the coherent state transform to the square $L_Q$. Eigenvalues of both of them exhibit the same phase transition: if $|I| |J| = |Q| = c$ then first $\approx c$ eigenvalues are very close to $1$, then there are $o(c)$ intermediate eigenvalues and the rest of the eigenvalues are very close to $0$.
